proposedContributions.change: Proposed BaseTable component consumes accepted queryRef, field descriptors, snapshot queryRevision/permissionEpoch/schemaRevision and view config; composes LSX-WP-012 ScalarCellEditor/cell-edit-command, not a duplicate scalar validator. Render a virtualized ARIA grid keyed by full EntityRef+fieldId; keep navigation/selection independent of visual indices; clear hidden/denied selections and protected caches on filter/revoke. Keep editor draft stable during virtualization/IME. Read summaries from the same authorized snapshot over the full filtered set, not mounted rows. Resize/reorder/pin have keyboard equivalents; persist shared widths/order through accepted config service and keep personal selection separate. Show explicit pending/conflict/denied/deleted/unsupported/offline/error states. Invoke accepted preview/apply paste transport and track each native receipt and authoritative readback before committed display.

Proposed PastePreview component displays server-authorized preview digest, pinned target EntityRefs/fieldIds/expected revisions/schema revision and eligible/skipped/invalid cells with reasons. Preserve quoted multiline Unicode clipboard values and locale-aware decimal/date interpretation via accepted typed parser. Confirm applies exactly the previewDigest; cancelling has zero writes. Surface per-cell native outcomes and conflict/local-current drafts; changed schema/ACL/revisions must invalidate/re-preview, not redirect target by visual row number.

Normative permanent behavior tests for mixed-owner multiline Unicode/decimal/date paste, denied/invalid targets never written, ref-stable selection after resort/virtualization/filter, snapshot summary ACL invariants, conflict/schema races, replay, native receipt/readback and restart. Preserve property seeds and baseline input hashes; mutation controls bypass typed patch validation or replace ref selection with visual indices and must fail the named semantic assertions. Do not replace real owner/readback lanes with mock-echo assertions.

Use the actual discovered Electron runner against integrated native Notes+Tasks and real base route. Exercise pointer and keyboard selection/edit/paste/column controls, virtualized focus, IME composition, Escape draft cancel, per-cell status announcements, hidden-target cleanup, 200% zoom, narrow layout, current themes, reduced motion, Russian labels/help and loaded font. Capture revision/environment-bound screenshots/ARIA/focus and native reload evidence.
